result_summary: Integrated the seven Alumnos lens returns plus Local Steward and Page Thread Bridge into one scoped candidate without inventing a singular teacher page or promoting child authority. The candidate resolves Alumnos as a coordination/routing surface over distinct owned products, specifies a one-message correction roundtrip through exact target/authority resolution, Page Change Thread, child execution, Local Steward and same-surface durable receipt, preserves shared Study and learner-state boundaries, and emits a deduplicated next-wave frontier. A late readiness audit also reproduced the DONE/COMPLETE terminal-state compatibility gap, so this return does not claim that the global readiness compiler is correct or that production /w is unlocked.
